sleuthkit.description: File extraction from disk images - Extract specific files by inode/path from .E01/.dd/.raw disk images. Use ONLY for file extraction, NOT for disk image analysis.

elastic.description: SIEM log search - Query Elasticsearch indices for security logs, Windows events, network logs. NOT for disk image analysis.

velociraptor.description: Live endpoint forensics - Collect Windows artifacts (registry, prefetch, event logs) from running systems via Velociraptor agent. NOT for disk image analysis.

ghidra.description: Binary/malware analysis - Reverse engineering, disassembly, decompilation of PE/ELF executable files. Use after extracting suspicious files.

virustotal.description: Threat intelligence - Check file hashes (MD5/SHA256), IPs, domains against VirusTotal database for malware detection.

browser-db-parser.description: Browser SQLite parser - Parse pre-extracted browser history SQLite files (Chrome History, Firefox places.sqlite, Edge History). LIMITATION: Cannot read E01 images directly. For E01 browser analysis, use dissect with browser.history plugin instead.

consolehost-history.description: PowerShell forensics from E01 disk images - Extract and parse ConsoleHost_history.txt for PowerShell command history. SUPPORTS: .E01/.dd/.raw disk images directly.

ez-tools.description: Windows artifact parsing - Parse pre-extracted Windows artifacts using Eric Zimmerman tools. LIMITATION: Cannot directly parse E01 images. Extract artifacts first using dissect/sleuthkit.

windows-notification.description: Windows notification forensics - Parse Windows notification database (wpndatabase.db) for app notifications.

jumplist.description: JumpList forensics - Parse Windows JumpList files (.automaticDestinations-ms, .customDestinations-ms) for recent file access.

lnk-parser.description: LNK file forensics from E01 disk images - Extract and parse Windows shortcut (.lnk) files for file access history. SUPPORTS: .E01/.dd/.raw disk images directly.

dissect.description: Disk image analysis - Multi-purpose disk image analysis using Dissect framework for .E01/.dd/.raw images. SUPPORTS: browser.history (Chrome/Firefox/Edge), prefetch, amcache, shellbags, shimcache, userassist, jumplist, registry analysis. Use for E01 browser history analysis and general Windows artifact collection.
